$comment: Source of truth for the review and dev-lead engines (#1973): which providers are enabled, which models exist, and each task's chain. Read by scripts/lib/engine-models.sh; validated by scripts/validate-ai-engines.py in lint.yml. Ships with the pr-review/* and dev-lead/* channel tags, so a change here canaries on next before ring0 and stable. AI_MODELS_* and AI_ENGINES override it in an emergency — fold the override back in here. See docs/engine-configuration.md.

notes: Triage primary; the haiku family's current id (ai_model_for_family haiku).
Default sonnet across triage, deep, action and duck (#1978, epic #1095 Phase 3).
In deep it is the last hop: deep's known-good hop is opus-4-8, so sonnet 5.5 alone is its sonnet tail (#1978 AC-2).
Known-good sonnet safety hop one behind sonnet 5.5 in triage and action.
The id is bare claude-sonnet-5: the claude-sonnet-5-0 spelling shipped by #1100 404s, so every hop to it silently fell through (#1957).
Deep primary since #1898 (epic #1895 Phase 2); audit and single primary since #1901 (epic #1895 Phase 3), replacing Fable 5.
CLI/API default reasoning effort is medium (low/medium/high/xhigh/max); engine.sh's run_agentic pins --effort high for deep, audit and single so moving off Fable does not lower their effort.
Known-good second hop behind opus-5-5 in deep, audit and single (#1957), so a throttled opus-5-5 degrades to the model it replaced.
Last hop of the audit and single chains.
Deprecated by #1901 (epic #1895 Phase 3): opus-5-5 outperforms it at lower cost, so no default chain names it.
Reasoning effort: the deep, audit and single tiers pin --effort high (engine.sh run_agentic) so replacing Fable with opus-5-5, whose default effort is medium, did not lower their effort.
A chain set through AI_MODELS_CLAUDE or CLAUDE_<TIER>_MODEL_CHAIN is still honoured as a stop-gap and warns once per run; its price rows stay for historical token records.
Triage and action primary; the known-working fallback of the quality tier.
Quality tier (deep, audit, single) since gemini-2.5-pro was withdrawn for new keys (#1960).
"No longer available to new users … use models/gemini-3.1-pro-preview": it broke every Gemini deep review while it sat in code (#1960).
GitHub Models id. Copilot has no in-engine chain, so each task names one model.

duck.$comment: Gemini and Copilot have no duck chain: their duck is the first model of their triage chain.
